name: Cryonic-Stele
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait massive canyon systems, and everything the light never reaches.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in exotic matter here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
